step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Prudential's automated data lake and warehouse ingestion pipeline on AWS Cloud. Data flows from external file systems and database sources through DataSync into a Landing zone (Amazon S3). Data is transformed via Glue DataBrew into a Standardize zone (Amazon S3 for data science/ML and Amazon Redshift for BI), and refined into a Refined S3 bucket with central access control managed by AWS Lake Formation. Consumers query data via Amazon Athena and SageMaker.
